preconditions.description: The number of strings k is between 1 and 2500 inclusive.
The length of each string n is between 2 and 5000 inclusive.
The total length of all strings does not exceed 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string in the input has exactly n characters.
Each string consists of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is either one of the input strings or '-1' if no such string exists.

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' or not all(any(sorted(s1) != sorted(s2) for s2 in strings) for s1 in strings)
postconditions.description: If the output is '-1', it is impossible to restore a string s that can be transformed into all input strings by swapping exactly two characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(sorted(stdout) == sorted(s) for s in strings)
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the sorted characters of the output string match the sorted characters of each input string.
